email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Media Planning Executive role at Publicis Groupe Belgium. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and web analytics, I'm drawn to the opportunity to build a strong foundation in media planning within your Strategy & Data team.

In my current roles, I work with data and budgets daily—tracking campaign performance in Google Analytics and Search Console, running keyword research, and reporting on results. I enjoy translating numbers into clear insights and have a critical mindset that pushes me to ask why and look for improvements. Collaborating with clients and internal stakeholders is part of my routine, and I'm comfortable coordinating tasks and deadlines.

I'm fluent in English and Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and eager to develop my media planning skills in a collaborative, creative environment. I'd welcome the chance to contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Media Planning Executive position at Publicis Groupe Belgium. Your focus on the Power of One—integrating strategy, creativity, media and production—resonates with my own experience working across digital marketing, SEO and web development. I'm eager to bring my analytical mindset and curiosity to your Strategy & Data team.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I've developed a strong comfort with numbers, data and budgets. I regularly use Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to track performance, conduct keyword research and report on results. This has taught me to pay close attention to detail and to translate data into actionable insights. I enjoy asking questions to understand the 'why' behind decisions and look for ways to improve processes—qualities that align with your emphasis on a critical mindset and ownership.

Collaboration is central to my work. I coordinate with clients and team members to meet deadlines, manage content updates and support campaign launches. For example, I've worked on multiple client websites, ensuring timely delivery and maintaining clear communication. I'm comfortable contributing in both internal and client-facing situations, and I know when to involve more experienced colleagues.

While my background is in digital marketing rather than traditional media planning, I'm deeply curious about the media landscape and how audiences, channels and touchpoints come together. I'm fluent in English and Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I'm confident in my ability to learn your methods and frameworks quickly. I'm drawn to Publicis Groupe's culture of difference and creativity, and I'd love to grow within your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your work.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Comfortable with numbers, data and budgets: daily use of Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs for tracking and reporting
• Critical mindset and attention to detail: run technical SEO audits, ask questions to understand decisions, and look for improvements
• Collaborative: coordinate with clients and team members to meet deadlines and support campaign launches
• Fluent in English and Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), with strong communication skills
• Curious about media and advertising: eager to learn how audiences, channels and touchpoints come together in a media plan
